last.verdict: Strong profit growth, but investors balked at a high valuation and slow margin gains.

reasons.label: Rich valuation
reasons.text: Shares trade near 97 times earnings, so even a doubling of profit left little room.

reasons.label: Margins still short
reasons.text: Gross margin edged up to 24.0% from 23.6%, still below the mid-to-high-20s goal.

reasons.label: Spending flattered profit
reasons.text: About $0.5M moved from marketing to retailer discounts, helping expenses fall to 18.5% of revenue.

story: Revenue growth has stayed strong: up 61% in the January quarter, about 50% in April, and 55% now. Profit has grown alongside it, but gross margin has stayed under 26%. A July stock offering raised about $108.6M for acquisitions.
